paragraphs.text: Jaxis , known as the Troublemaker , is a human warrior affiliated with the Riveteers family in New Capenna .

Within the gritty boxing rings of New Capenna's most downtrodden boroughs, one name rises above the rest: Jaxis, the Troublemaker. She is a fierce and skilled fighter, widely regarded as one of the finest boxers the city has ever seen. Her right hook strikes with the force of the Capenna main line, while her jab is relentless and powerful like a jackhammer. Jaxis remains undefeated, a record that has begun to stir whispers and hopes among the people.

Her reputation was solidified when a group of assassins sent by the Maestros attempted to eliminate her. Despite being heavily outnumbered—five to one—Jaxis found herself suddenly surrounded by burning shadows . These spectral figures were instantly recognizable to the onlookers: they were champions from New Capenna's past and present, some of whom she had faced in the ring, others long retired or deceased. Called forth by some unknown power, these champions fought alongside her, driving off the assassins to the roaring approval of the crowd. The people now see Jaxis not only as the best fighter alive but as a blessed figure. Though demons may dominate New Capenna’s streets, warriors like Jaxis embody hope for the city's inhabitants.
